courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: We had a look at the variables.scss file where you can setup your colors or general application wide
this should only be used for variables.
So if you've got other global stylings you want to set up, you should do that here in the global.scss
So if you want to set something like body margin 100px, do it here,
only set up variables in that variables.scss file, any other styling where you want to assign to
a concrete CSS property instead of a CSS variable should go into the global.scss file if it
is a global styling or if it is a component specific styling,
of course in the scss file of that component.
Now as you can see here in the global.scss file, we are importing a bunch of CSS files out of the box
and you should leave these imports there,
they set up a general look and feel for the Ionic application but below these imports, you can add any
global styling for any element or any rule you want to add. You can there use these variables if you
want but you can also of course just hardcode any values, whatever your goal is in your application.
